text: Implemented detect ConfigurationError plus private opaque parsers for WindowHalfWidth, MissingPadding, InterpolationGap, MinimumEventDuration, IvtThreshold, EkMultiplier, and EkMinimumSamples. Filter and detector constructors now accept only validated values and still return plain composable Machine values. EkThresholds now has a private constructor and finite-positive builder; threshold estimation returns Either[EkEstimationError, EkThresholds] distinguishing insufficient velocity support from degenerate spread. Runtime boundary cases and typeCheckErrors reject raw constructor inputs. Verification: DetectSuite JVM 33/33 and JS 33/33; StreamingSuite JVM 6/6 and JS 6/6; compileAll, checkBoundaries, and focused Scalafmt checks pass. A deliberate >= 0 half-width mutant failed the exact zero-boundary test (32 pass, 1 fail); restoration returned 33/33. TrustRegressionSuite still yields the intended identical 12 pre-fix failures and 6 controls on JVM and JS.
